pitfalls.name: Creating unconnected ontology elements
pitfalls.description: Ontology elements (classes, object properties and datatype properties) are created isolated, with no relation to the rest of the ontology.

pitfalls.name: Missing domain or range in properties
pitfalls.description: Object and/or datatype properties without domain or range (or none of them) are included in the ontology.

pitfalls.name: Inverse relationships not explicitly declared
